items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Bach Kay. I used to remember him. Yeah. But he wasn't no crackerjack.

ctx.x: Or a shield Bach Kay. A clarinet player. With the name of Bach Kay. Do you remember? Played with Jack Lane a long time.
Bach Kay. I used to remember him. Yeah. But he wasn't no crackerjack. But the best clarinet player that ever I played with was a boy by the name of Eddie Falk.
He came up in that American Brass Band.
